officialEvidence.documentTitle: CAOA CHERY TIGGO 5X — Manual do Proprietário

findings: General contractual coverage is 36 months without a mileage limit, including the initial statutory period, subject to the manual’s specific limitations and exclusions.
Coverage starts on delivery of the zero-kilometer vehicle to its first owner. Rights transfer to subsequent owners only until the original term ends.
Combustion engine and transmission receive a further 24 months without a mileage limit.
Commercial use is limited to 36 months or 100,000 km, whichever occurs first.
Warranty validation requires the authorized dealer sale invoice and updated warranty/revision records; prescribed maintenance and operating recommendations remain conditions.
Optional 48 V battery has a separate 60-month / 120,000-km provision, not adopted as coverage for this unit.

warrantyPages.section: Período de Garantia para Peças Especiais, item 20
findings: The table independently states 60 months without a mileage limit for combustion engine and transmission, excluding commercial vehicles.
Other components and wear items have separate durations and/or mileage limits; this is not five-year general coverage.

officialEvidence.verification: Extracted complete relevant pages and visually inspected rendered PDF pages 297, 298 and 299; table item 20 and adjacent exclusions checked.
officialEvidence.metadataNote: PDF metadata reports creation in April 2023 and modification in May 2026; applicability comes from the official portal edition link and the printed April 2023 publication, not from modification metadata.
